ai_summary: Aditya Birla Real Estate Limited (ABREL) has received an improved, unsolicited ESG rating of "Crisil ESG-60" for FY2026, up from "CRISIL ESG 58" in FY2025, signaling a positive trend in its environmental, social, and governance performance. This independent assessment, based on public data, enhances ABREL's market perception and appeal to ESG-focused investors, though the "adequate" categorization suggests ongoing opportunities for further improvement, with no direct red flags noted.
